data.name: posthog-cli/v0.18.12
data.body:
## Release Notes

### Patch changes

- [ecfc9561b36](https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/commit/ecfc9561b36d36d2db98f5ec3f85abe4c22e5980) Correlate symbol set upload batches within a CLI run — Thanks @hpouillot!

## Install posthog-cli 0.18.12

### Install prebuilt binaries via shell script

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://releases.posthog.com/posthog-cli/v0.18.12/posthog-cli-installer.sh | sh
```

### Install prebuilt binaries via powershell script

```sh
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://releases.posthog.com/posthog-cli/v0.18.12/posthog-cli-installer.ps1 | iex"
```

### Install prebuilt binaries via Homebrew

```sh
brew install PostHog/tap/posthog-cli
```

### Install prebuilt binaries into your npm project

```sh
npm install @posthog/cli@0.18.12
```

 WORKDIR /code
 SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-e", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]
 
@@ -71,7 +71,7 @@ RUN bin/turbo --filter=@posthog/frontend build
 # Isolated stage for sourcemap upload - keeps secrets and external network calls
 # out of the main build cache. This stage produces no artifacts for the final image.

-FROM node:24.13.0-bookworm-slim AS sourcemap-upload
+FROM node:24.22.1-bookworm-slim AS sourcemap-upload
 WORKDIR /code
 SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-e", "-o", "pipefail", "-c"]

@@ -11,7 +11,7 @@

+# Exact node version pinned to .nvmrc (24.22.1), matching the main Dockerfile's node stages, so the

 #
@@ -34,7 +34,7 @@ RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/usr/local/cargo/registry,sharing=locked \

-FROM node:24.13.0-bookworm-slim
+FROM node:24.22.1-bookworm-slim
 WORKDIR /code/app

@@ -86,7 +86,7 @@ RUN NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=16384" bin/turbo --filter=@posthog/nodejs
